data.name: Crane Game Master
data.detailed_description:
About The Game

The crane game everyone fell in love with at the arcade is back—with an absolute (and ridiculous) scale!

Claw Machine Master is an exhilarating and surreal simulation game where you control a physics-based claw arm to grab a wide variety of awesome prizes.

Key Features

■ Various Types of Claw Machines & a Variety of Prizes!

It's not just about grabbing prizes! Conquer machines with various rules and styles (Bridge drop, Takoyaki/Ping-pong drop, Payout machines...?!). Everyone has their own tactics. Develop your own techniques to win the prizes!

■ Pro Tactics: Dual-Angle Camera Switching

The key to mastering any claw machine is precision. Smoothly switch between the Front View and Side View at the press of a button. Master the depth perception, align your claw perfectly, and make that god-tier drop!

■ Admire Your Collection! "3D Gallery Feature"

The awesome prizes you work so hard to win can be viewed anytime in your personal Gallery! Click on any prize in the gallery to inspect it in full 3D from any angle you want. Complete the collection and build the ultimate showcase!

■ Out of Cash? Earn It Through Two "Hard Labors"

Playing isn't free. If your wallet goes empty because you got too hooked, it's time to work and earn your paycheck!

・Top-Down Shooter "Space Defense": Blast away incoming enemies to protect the universe! And earn some coins for your next play!

・Side-Scrolling Action "Food Delivery": Dash through the streets, deliver food to homes, and grab those coins on the way!

And what do you do with your hard-earned money? That's right—dump every single cent right back into the machine for another round!

Become the Ultimate Master!

Labor, shooting, delivering, and claw machines.

Can you survive this adrenaline-fueled endless cycle, collect every single prize, and claim the title of the true Claw Machine Master!?

[Streaming & Video Policy]

Feel free to stream or post gameplay videos and screenshots, including those with monetization.

We welcome all creators—individuals and companies alike—to share their experiences with our game!

If possible, please include a link to our Steam store page in your video description.

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
